$comment: Drives deploy/register-connector.{sh,ps1} for the Foundry IQ provider. See README 'Registration'.

inputs.name: search-service
inputs.description: Azure AI Search service name (the part before .search.windows.net).

inputs.name: search-resource-group
inputs.description: Resource group of the search service.

inputs.name: knowledge-bases
inputs.description: Comma-separated allowlist of knowledge base names.

inputs.name: content-description
inputs.default: documents from Foundry IQ knowledge bases
inputs.description: What the data is; goes into tool descriptions.

inputs.name: use-preview-api
inputs.description: true to use the preview retrieve API (citationUrl, sensitivity labels).

settings.$comment: Container app environment variables. ${VAR} is substituted from inputs and .env.<env>. KNOWLEDGE_BASES expands to one Name entry per knowledge base.
